title: feat(programs): coach Programs tab - build once, assign to many, add to package (S-MWB Phase 1 mobile, T3)
body:
**Tier: T3**
**Why:** the coach can now run bulk writes across many clients (bulk assign) and attach a program to packages that deliver to every paying or $0-granted client. Both go through backend routes from growth-project-backend#640; this PR is the reachable UI for them.
**T4 trigger scan:** no auth, payments, RLS, secrets or deletion logic in this repo's diff. The package attach call uses the existing `/v1/coach/packages/:id/contents` route. **Release-config hunk:** `eas.json` clinic profile turns on `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_MWB_PROGRAMS` and `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_MWB_AUTOSAVE`. This is an operator decision: drop the hunk to ship dark. If the flags stay on, the backend flags listed below have to be on at deploy. If they are not, the tab shows "Programs are not switched on" with a support path. It does not show a broken screen.
**T3 trigger scan:** cross-repo contract (`/v1/coach/programs`, `workout_program` asset id = master program id); bulk writes across clients; package delivery authoring.
**Bounded T1:** NO.
**Builder/owner:** S-MWB-111 (Claude Opus 5.5 builder lane), operator agent 111; fix round S-MWB-2 (operator agent 112); fix round S-MWB-3 (operator agent 113); fix round S-MWB-4 (operator agent 114).
**Acceptance evidence:** see Tests and the S-MWB-3 fix round (7 suites, 114 tests pass; the new tests fail on the pre-fix source, 34 failures). Customer outcome: a coach builds the men's intro program once in a week-by-day grid, using the existing workout builder for each day. They can then assign it to many clients from a start date and see a result for each client. They can also add it to a package (including $0) without typing an id.
**Promotion triggers:** the reviewer judges the eas.json flag flip to be release gating, or the backend PR is re-graded. Either one moves this PR to T4.

Depends on growth-project-backend#640 (routes 404 `programs_unavailable` until it ships with FEATURE_MWB_TEMPLATES=true). Merge and deploy #640 first: the builder now sends `expected_head_index` on Undo. An older backend ignores it, because the field is optional and only adds the fence.

## What a coach can do (flag on)
- **Programs tab** (replaces "Templates"; route name kept so existing links work; flag off = legacy screen byte-identical):
  - Program library with search, goal-tag chips and active or archived filters.
  - Each card shows weeks x days, filled days out of total slots, clients assigned, package count, a regime badge, and "read only" for team programs.
  - Saved-workouts library: new standalone workout opens the existing builder.
- **Program editor:**
  - Grid of weeks x 7 day slots. Tapping a slot opens a panel under that week.
  - A filled day can be opened in the existing `CoachWorkoutBuilder` (registered in this stack; autosave applies when `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_MWB_AUTOSAVE` is on) or cleared.
  - An empty day can be filled with a new blank workout (opens the builder straight away), a saved workout, or a copy of another day.
  - Program actions: edit details (sends `expected_version`; a conflict reloads), duplicate, history and clients (revisions, assignees, remove client), promote to named regime, and archive or restore (refused while a live package delivers it, with the package named).
  - Screen readers get custom actions (Select, Open in workout builder) on every cell.
- **Assign:**
  - Multi-select clients with search and select-all-shown. Start date from Today, Tomorrow or Next Monday, or typed YYYY-MM-DD (validated).
  - Optional "assign again" for clients already on the program.
  - Sends chunks of 50 and shows progress, then a result per client (assigned with date span, already on it, or failed with the reason).
  - "Retry N failed" reuses the same Idempotency-Key, so the server never assigns anyone twice.
- **Add to package:**
  - Lists the coach's packages with price ($0 shown as Free), status and client count. Packages that already include the program are marked.
  - Attach uses `cadence immediate`. The confirmation says that existing members need Push to existing.
  - With the flag on, `ContentAttachForm` gets a program or saved-workout picker. The raw id field stays as a fallback.
- **Errors:** `src/utils/programErrors.ts` maps every backend code to specific, recoverable copy. Unknown failures show a short reference (server `request_id` when present), a Contact support path (SupportInbox is registered in the stack) and a Sentry event under the same reference. There is no bare generic message.

## Not in this PR (open gaps)
- **Builder undo button:** built in the fix round (see below).
- Sub-coach day access: the backend fix round (#640) lets an in-team sub-coach open a day of a team program they own or one shared with the team. The head coach's owner-only programs stay closed.
- Drag-and-drop day moves: not built. Copy day plus clear day covers it.

## Tests (targeted, `--runInBand`, via heavy.sh)
Original round: `npx jest --runInBand src/api/__tests__/programsApi.test.ts src/utils/__tests__/programErrors.test.ts src/screens/coach/programs/__tests__/programsScreens.test.tsx src/__tests__/ContentAttachForm.test.tsx scripts/__tests__/expectedEnv.test.js src/config/__tests__/featureFlagsReleaseInlining.test.ts src/navigation/__tests__/coachNavigation.test.ts`: all pass.
Fix round S-MWB-2 at 67f9ef4:
- `npx jest --runInBand src/screens/coach/programs/__tests__/programsFixRound.test.tsx src/screens/coach/programs/__tests__/programsScreens.test.tsx src/api/__tests__/programsApi.test.ts src/utils/__tests__/programErrors.test.ts src/__tests__/coachWorkoutBuilderUndo.test.tsx src/__tests__/coachWorkoutBuilderAutosave.test.tsx src/__tests__/coachWorkoutBuilderRowIdAdoption.test.tsx src/hooks/__tests__/useAutosave.test.tsx`: 8 suites, 81 tests, all pass (one suite timed out on the first run under shared-sandbox load and passed on rerun).
- `npx jest --runInBand src/__tests__/quietLuxuryDoctrine.test.ts src/screens/coach/programs/__tests__/programsFixRound.test.tsx src/screens/coach/programs/__tests__/programsScreens.test.tsx src/navigation/__tests__/coachNavigation.test.ts src/__tests__/ContentAttachForm.test.tsx`: 5 suites, 35 tests, pass.
- `npx tsc --noEmit`: exit 0. ESLint on the 14 changed files: exit 0. Banned-cast grep on the diff: none. Prettier on changed files (files already unformatted on main left as they were).

## Flags
New: `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_MWB_PROGRAMS` (featureFlags.mwbPrograms, literal key, default off; registered in `config/expected-env.json`). Uses the existing `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_MWB_AUTOSAVE`.
Backend (#637 manifest, not edited here): `FEATURE_MWB_TEMPLATES=true`, `FEATURE_MWB_AUTOSAVE_UNDO=true` + `MWB_AUTOSAVE_LOCK_TOKEN_SECRET`, `FEATURE_NAMED_REGIMES=true`.

## Fix round (S-MWB-2, operator 112): Opus REQUEST CHANGES 5958240427 + AUD-SOL-4 REQUEST CHANGES 5960191675, both at dbd5ceb
Merged main 2c17c24 (merge commit e4adaf7). Code fixes in 67f9ef4.

| Finding | Change | Commit | Proof |
|---|---|---|---|
| CI quietLuxuryDoctrine (round 1) | all Programs styles use 600; hierarchy by size | dbd5ceb | `quietLuxuryDoctrine.test.ts` PASS |
| B-328-1 assign key survives a new intent (both lenses) | Key is scoped to program + start date + repeat. Changing date or repeat rotates it and clears old results. A clean run retires it; only "Retry failed" reuses it. Date and repeat are locked while sending. Rows the server confirmed from an earlier attempt are counted separately. | 67f9ef4 | `programsFixRound.test.tsx` B-328-1 (mirrors the Sol probe) |
| B-328-2 unknown create outcome rotates key (Sol) | No response, 408 or 5xx keeps the key and the exact body; fields lock with a notice ("we could not confirm..."); Save resends the same request. A definite 4xx releases the key. | 67f9ef4 | `programsFixRound.test.tsx` B-328-2 |
| B-328-3 401/403/429/400 copy (Sol) | 401: sign in again, with a Sign in again button. 429: wait a minute. Bare 403: access copy with reference and support. 400: server reason (validation arrays joined) with reference, support path and Sentry. `isOutcomeUnknown` helper. | 67f9ef4 | `programErrors.test.ts` |
| B-328-4 conflict reload pairs stale body with fresh version (Sol) | The form rebases on each new server version. Untouched fields take the server value. A field changed on both sides shows Keep mine / Use latest, and Save waits until it is resolved. | 67f9ef4 | `programsFixRound.test.tsx` B-328-4 |
| C-640-10 (contract) assignees paging | `programsApi.assignees(id, cursor)` returns `{items, next_cursor}`; history uses an infinite query with "Show more clients" and a page error box. | 67f9ef4 | `programsApi.test.ts` |
| C-328-2 merge order | Merge and deploy #640 first. With the backend flags off, the tab shows "Programs are not switched on" with a support path. | n/a | note |
| Lane: builder undo button | Undo / Redo buttons in the workout builder (autosave flag on, existing plan). The current edit is saved first, then `POST /workout-plans/:id/undo`, then a refetch, then the server state is applied. The hook moves to the new head with `useAutosave.adoptServerHead`, so the next save does not hit a conflict. Each failure has its own copy: revision pruned, no access, session, offline. An unknown failure shows a reference, a support path and a Sentry event. | 67f9ef4 | `coachWorkoutBuilderUndo.test.tsx` (5 tests) |

## Fix round (S-MWB-3, operator 113): Opus REQUEST CHANGES 5963112779 (0/2/2) + AUD-SOL-10 REQUEST CHANGES 5963070668 (0/2/1), both at 67f9ef4
Merged main 17e4c11 (98427e7) and aae30ac (4810a3f), both clean. Fixes in 6df2309 and ab8bdc8. f4a6ecf removes a `node_modules` symlink that 6df2309 added by mistake.

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-328-5 Undo/Redo can wipe edits made while it is in flight (both) | A history barrier (`historyGate`) is raised BEFORE the pre-undo flush and held until the outcome is known. While it is up the builder is read-only: name, type, duration, sets/reps/rest, search and add, move and remove, Save, the status-pill flush and the leave flush. The edit handlers also refuse. The server copy reaches the screen only after `adoptServerHead` returns true. If it refuses, the screen is left alone and the replay-adoption path folds server truth in. | 6df2309 | `coachWorkoutBuilderUndo.test.tsx` B-328-5 (deferred undo while the coach types and removes a row: nothing changes, nothing is queued, the editor reopens on the server copy) |
| B-328-6 lost Undo response reported as nothing was undone (both) | Undo and Redo send `expected_head_index` (live head from the new `useAutosave.readHead()`). No response, 5xx, abort, an unreadable 200 or a non-HTTP error is an UNKNOWN outcome. The copy says the app could not confirm whether the change was undone. Editing stays paused and Check again resends with the SAME fence: a 200 applies it, and a 409 `undo_head_moved` one step ahead confirms that the earlier request landed. Further ahead means another session moved the plan, so the screen shows the latest version and resets history. If the undo landed but its copy did not load, editing stays paused until Check again loads it. Only a definite refusal (401/403/404/other 4xx/parsed 409) says nothing was undone. Network copy names the connection; other unknown outcomes carry a reference, the support path and a Sentry event. | 6df2309 | `coachWorkoutBuilderUndo.test.tsx` (commit then lost response then retry, 5xx then retry, failed reconciliation fetch twice then success, moved elsewhere, definite 403), `workoutBuilderUndo.test.ts`, `workoutAutosaveApi.test.ts` (fence sent, `undo_head_moved` parsed) |
| C-328-7 clinic-set codes and the 409/422 fallback | KNOWN copy for `program_in_clinic_set` and `program_in_clinic_set_needs_a_day` (support path). An unmapped 4xx with a server message shows that message plus the reference; an unmapped 404 says it no longer exists and offers reload; the 5xx copy no longer says "our side". `program_version_conflict` and the unconfirmed-save notice drop the first person. | 6df2309, ab8bdc8 | `programErrors.test.ts` C-328-7 block, `programsFixRound.test.tsx` |
| C-328-2 merge order | #640 first (see above). `dropRow.buyerStatusOf` needs no change: the backend now maps `delivered` to `fired` (B-640-12). | n/a | note |

Commands (heavy.sh, `CI=true`, `--runInBand`): `npx jest src/__tests__/coachWorkoutBuilderUndo.test.tsx src/screens/coach/__tests__/workoutBuilderUndo.test.ts src/api/__tests__/workoutAutosaveApi.test.ts src/utils/__tests__/programErrors.test.ts src/hooks/__tests__/useAutosave.test.tsx src/__tests__/coachWorkoutBuilderAutosave.test.tsx src/__tests__/coachWorkoutBuilderRowIdAdoption.test.tsx`: 114 tests pass. On the first run, the flag-off test in `coachWorkoutBuilderAutosave` timed out at 20 s on a cold start under shared load; the suite then passed alone, 10/10. `programsFixRound.test.tsx` + `quietLuxuryDoctrine.test.ts`: 17/17. With the source changes stashed, the new tests give 34 failures. ESLint on the changed files: exit 0. Banned-cast grep on the diff: none.

## Fix round 4 (S-MWB-4, operator 114): CI red at 4810a3f + OR-112-18 mobile half
Merged main 1f8981dd (533594ba, clean).

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| CI red at 4810a3f: `TS2339 Property 'phase' does not exist on type 'never'` (`CoachWorkoutBuilderScreen.tsx:1418`) | The entry guard narrowed `historyGateRef.current` to null and TypeScript kept that narrowing after the awaits. The `finally` reads the live phase through `historyGatePhase(ref)`; behaviour unchanged. | 98d652f | CI Typecheck green at 533594ba; `coachWorkoutBuilderUndo.test.tsx` passes |
| OR-112-18 mobile half: a save refused for access showed "Offline — saved on device, will sync" (false: it never syncs) | `useAutosave` exposes `refusal {status, code}` on a 403 (batch still kept, never a silent loss; cleared by the next 200). The pill shows "Not saved — no edit access"; the builder shows per-code copy (`program_read_only`, `client_not_assigned`, `plan_not_yours`, `plan_access_denied`; an unknown 403 gets the not-shared copy) from `workoutBuilderAccess.ts`. | dd34763 | `src/__tests__/workoutBuilderAccess.test.tsx`, `useAutosave.test.tsx` S-MWB-4 block, `coachWorkoutBuilderAutosave.test.tsx` S-MWB-4 case |
| Read-only team program still offered "Open in workout builder" as an accessibility action | The day cell offers the builder action (and handles it) only when `can_edit`, matching the visible button. | dd34763 | `programsScreens.test.tsx` S-MWB-4 case |

Commands (heavy.sh, `CI=true`, `--runInBand`): `npx jest src/__tests__/workoutBuilderAccess.test.tsx src/hooks/__tests__/useAutosave.test.tsx src/screens/coach/programs/__tests__/programsScreens.test.tsx src/__tests__/coachWorkoutBuilderAutosave.test.tsx src/__tests__/coachWorkoutBuilderUndo.test.tsx src/screens/coach/programs/__tests__/programsFixRound.test.tsx`: all pass. With the source changes removed, the new tests fail (3 failures plus the missing-module suite). ESLint on the changed files: 0 errors. Merge order unchanged: backend #640 first (the refusal codes come from it; an older backend's bare 403 gets the not-shared copy).
